data.reason: An electric toothbrush with a self-contained motor is generally classified in 8509.80 (electro-mechanical domestic appliances) in Chapter 85. Some customs authorities treat it as 9603 (brushes) in Chapter 96, but that chapter is not offered, so Chapter 85 is the best fit among the options shown.
